title: Parse errors that carry the line number
task: In package `props` implement `Parse(text string) (map[string]string, error)` for `key=value` lines. When a line has no `=`, an empty key, or a duplicate key, callers need the line number and the reason both in the message and available programmatically, so they can point at the line in an editor; name the error type `ParseError`. An empty document is a valid empty result. Test a good document and each failure with its line number.
